items.t: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
items.en: To Allah we belong and unto Him is our return. O Allah, recompense me for my affliction and replace it for me with something better.
items.tl: Innā li-llāhi wa innā ilayhi rājiʿūna, allāhumma jurnī fī muṣībatī, wa akhlif lī khayrā minhā
